title: Thermodynamic Property Calculation Engine — Overview and definition
t: Thermodynamic Property Calculation Engine — Overview and definition
description: Computes enthalpies, entropies, equilibria, and phase behavior from data.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Computes enthalpies, entropies, equilibria, and phase behavior from data. A thermodynamic property engine evaluates equations of state (ideal, cubic, REFPROP-style multiparameter) and Gibbs-energy minimization for phase equilibria. Real implementations include CoolProp, REFPROP, and Thermo-Calc. It covers pure fluids, mixtures, and reacting systems with documented uncertainty.
